items.title: The River Remembers
items.expression_directive: Quiet, reflective and contemplative; only restrained natural warmth, not a camera-facing smile.
items.scene_prompt:
Create one original finished image for PicMagic, not a prompt, mockup or explanation. The River Remembers.

VISUAL STORY: A traveller rests an open journal on a ghat step. One river edge flows out of its page as translucent ink, becoming a real river behind the person; the face, hand and nearest stone remain photographic. The transition follows a curved shoreline, never a straight split.

FICTIONAL PREVIEW PERSONA / PRODUCT: One fictional Indian woman about 42, deep-brown complexion, short wavy hair, ordinary build, in an indigo cotton shirt; copper river light, cream paper and one indigo ink channel. Three-quarter framing, face large and unobscured.

COMPOSITION: 4:5 vertical, target 1200 × 1500 pixels. Design the whole frame deliberately. The visual story must read at a mobile-card size; keep all important faces and objects comfortably inside the edges.

PRESERVATION: One recognizable face and actual proportions; keep the photographic face outside the painted region.
PERMITTED TRANSFORMATIONS: Environment edges and blank journal artwork into flowing ink; adapt practical clothing and a quiet glance.

QUALITY CONTROLS: Ink must not cross facial landmarks or imply the person is dissolving; avoid tiny journal detail as the only hook. Follow believable anatomy, coherent physical shadows, natural varied expressions and age-appropriate details. No beauty-filter skin, accidental duplicate people, malformed hands, branded creative assets, captions, logos, watermarks or frame around the artwork. Texture and rendering must match the specified photographic, illustration or craft medium; do not force photographic skin onto an explicitly paper or print interpretation.
